text:
kai: quick sketch: microfastpath + groomer. separate tiny fastpath for <40-token requests with soft per-tenant quotas; an async groomer packs leftovers into bulk when GPU idle. purpose: reduce short-request p99 without destroying batch efficiency.

maria: soft quotas only? how do we avoid a single noisy tenant burning the fastpath?

kai: quotas decay over time and admission has jitter. noisy tenants hit token limits and get routed to bulk. we expose tenant_quota as a tunable.

tj: packing by groomer sounds risky for OOMs. need strict pack headroom.

lee: add pack_headroom_tokens and a pack_efficiency target. if efficiency falls below threshold, groomer backs off.

anya: KV cache concerns: many tiny varied prefixes will spike misses. groomer should prefer grouping by prefix-hash to reduce churn.

kai: agree. config sketch: 
queues:
  microfastpath:
    token_limit: 40
    slot_ttl_ms: 40
    soft_quota_tokens_per_tenant: 200
    quota_decay_ms: 1000
groomer:
  interval_ms: 12
  max_pack_tokens: 4096
  pack_headroom_tokens: 512
  locality_buckets: 8
routing:
  util_floor_pct: 70
  hysteresis_ms: 300

lee: telemetry: microfastpath.p99, groomer.pack_efficiency, kvcache.miss.by_lane, batch.fill_ratio. alert on microfastpath.p99 regressions.

tj: tests: state-machine invariants, groomer fuzz with skewed prefixes, OVF safety.

maria: rollout: feature-flag "microfastpath_groomer_v1". canary 2% -> 20% with synthetic mixed traces. watch p99/p995 and tokens/sec.

ops-bot: infra note: register feature-flag and add kill-switch + runbook for the rollout.

kai: next steps: prototype in staging runner, collect kv_miss deltas and batch metrics, open RFC PR with plots. tagging @maria @tj for review.
maria: SGTM. include cost delta and tail plots.
tj: ping when PR is ready.
